facts.fact: On 18 May 2026 the Council of Ministers adopted the decree applying ordonnance n°2026-21 of 22 April 2026 on the civil-status regime: it sets the organisation and equipment of civil-status services and the registration supports and, 'in the perspective of the full computerisation of the civil-status system through the Registre National de l'Etat Civil (RNEC)', which the ordonnance institutes, the rules for managing, processing, using and keeping the RNEC.

The decree on the civil-status regime and the RNEC was adopted on 18 May 2026 under the heading of the Ministère de l'Intérieur, de la Sécurité Publique et de l'Administration du Territoire, in the government's own communiqué.

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, de la Sécurité Publique et de l'Administration du Territoire
systems.tiers: not stated; full computerisation of the civil-status system is a 'perspective'
